deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether Terraform can destroy the multicast domain activation. Platform policy should enforce PREVENT so accidental or unintended Terraform changes cannot destructively remove the resource without an explicit, reviewed lifecycle change.

description.description: An optional text description of the multicast domain activation.
description.rationale: Provides human-readable metadata only. It has no effect on authentication, authorization, encryption, networking, or any other security property of the resource.

disable_placement_policy.description:
Option to allow disabling placement policy for multicast infrastructure.
Only applicable if the activation is for a domain associating with a multicast domain group.
disable_placement_policy.rationale: Controls infrastructure placement behaviour for multicast infrastructure rather than access control or data protection. Constraining this setting would not provide a generic security improvement.

labels.description:
Labels as key-value pairs

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are metadata used for organisation, automation, or billing. While useful for governance, they do not directly affect the security posture of the multicast domain activation.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region or zone where the multicast domain activation is created. A platform security policy can restrict deployments to an approved region whitelist to satisfy data residency, regulatory, and organisational requirements without relying on team-specific values.

multicast_domain.description:
The resource name of the multicast domain to activate.
Use the following format:
'projects/*/locations/global/multicastDomains/*'.
multicast_domain.rationale: References an existing multicast domain resource. The appropriate domain depends on workload requirements, making this unsuitable for a generic platform-wide security policy.

multicast_domain_activation_id.description:
A unique name for the multicast domain activation.
The name is restricted to letters, numbers, and hyphen, with the first
character a letter, and the last a letter or a number. The name must not
exceed 48 characters.
multicast_domain_activation_id.rationale: Serves only as a unique resource identifier. Naming conventions may support operations but do not directly improve the security of the resource.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Specifies the Google Cloud project containing the resource. Restricting projects requires organisation-specific knowledge rather than a reusable platform security policy.

traffic_spec.description:
Specifies the traffic volume and multicast group scale parameters that are
used to set up multicast infrastructure for a multicast domain in a zone.

traffic_spec.aggr_egress_pps.description:
Aggregated egress Packet-Per-Second for all multicast groups in the domain
in this zone.
traffic_spec.aggr_egress_pps.rationale: Sets aggregate egress capacity for infrastructure sizing; the appropriate threshold is a team-dependent operational metric, not a platform security control.

traffic_spec.aggr_ingress_pps.description:
Aggregated ingress Packet-Per-Second for all multicast groups in the domain
in this zone. Default to (aggregated_egress_pps /
max_per_group_subscribers) * 2.
traffic_spec.aggr_ingress_pps.rationale: Sets expected ingress throughput for provisioning; performance and capacity thresholds are operational choices outside platform security scope.

traffic_spec.avg_packet_size.rationale: Provides an average packet-size estimate for capacity planning and infrastructure sizing, not security enforcement.

traffic_spec.max_per_group_ingress_pps.description:
Maximum ingress Packet-Per-Second for a single multicast group in this
zone. Default to aggregated_ingress_pps / 2.
traffic_spec.max_per_group_ingress_pps.rationale: Sets a per-group traffic rate used for scaling and capacity planning, making it an operational parameter rather than a security policy target.

traffic_spec.max_per_group_subscribers.description:
Maximum number of subscribers for a single multicast group in this zone.
Default to max(50, aggregated_egress_pps / aggregated_ingress_pps).
traffic_spec.max_per_group_subscribers.rationale: Sets a subscriber-count assumption for capacity and scalability planning, which is an operational choice rather than a platform security control.
